body.name: Branch-dual saddle handle for unrestricted two-batch design
body.construction: For the variance vector \(s\), optimize the joint finite-branch Gaussian rate over an interior first-batch allocation \(a\in\mathcal W\), a first-batch fraction, and branch-specific interior survivor allocations \(b(e)\), using the dual multipliers of the elimination and terminal polyhedra as a saddle-point certificate over \(\mathfrak D_2^{\mathrm{all}}\).
